name: Superman Push-Up
instructions: Begin in a standard push-up position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your body down as in a regular push-up.
At the bottom, explosively push up with maximum force.
As you push up, extend your arms forcefully enough to lift your entire body off the ground.
At the peak of the movement, extend your arms forward in front of you like Superman flying.
Quickly bring your hands back underneath you before landing.
Land with your hands in position and immediately lower into the next repetition.
This is an advanced plyometric movement requiring significant upper body power.
